_note: THE FIRST SPARK: the one scarce, single-winner contest. Shared Legends (events.json) are unchanged and stay contribution-for-all. All numbers are hypotheses unless marked fixed. Stage 2 (WP-20); not in the Meadow slice.
name: The First Spark
fantasy: A white-gold Spark that crosses each arena once an hour. It touches down five times. Three rings catch it. One player wears the crown.

schedule.clock: UTC wall clock, identical on every server, so changing servers cannot find another one
schedule.start: at the mark if the arena round clock is between 5 s and 80 s; otherwise at the first moment it is. Worst-case delay 45 s

announce.where: menu Play tab and every records board

announce.cue: sky beam over glint 1 + toast 'The First Spark is coming'
all five glints light, numbered 1 to 5, with a thin sky-line joining them in order

schedule.replaces: that round's Golden Runaway is skipped if the two would overlap
schedule.privateServers: same schedule; crowns count (the daily cap below is what bounds farming)

course.route: each arena's route with kind 'glint' (5 points, 30-60 studs apart)

restSeconds.note: catchable only while resting on a glint

streakSeconds.note: uncatchable arc between glints, always this long regardless of distance

course.telegraph: the next glint pulses during the streak; a rest shows a shrinking halo that is the 2.6 s timer
course.note: it does not flee and cannot be herded or booped: the test is being there and ringing cleanly

capture.oneRingPerRest: the first valid loop around it at a rest lands a ring; it then streaks on at once

photoFinish.rule: every valid claim that reaches the server within this window of the first valid claim competes; the SMALLEST server-measured loop area takes the ring. Removes ping as the decider

capture.expiry: after the fifth rest it leaves. Fewer than 3 rings: it escapes, nobody is crowned, ring scores are kept, nothing is lost

winner.rule: when the third ring lands, the player who landed the MOST rings wins the crown
ties: smallest total server-measured area across their rings
winner.why: the last ring is not special, so finishing someone else's work hands THEM the crown and you the assist: there is nothing to steal and every reason to finish

eligibility.toRing: any player in the arena who is playing the round (not sitting out, not in the Daily Stampede), including someone who joined the arena or the server mid-window
eligibility.toBeCrowned: has not already been crowned in this arena this UTC day
eligibility.ifTopContributorIsCapped: the crown passes to the next player in the ranking; the capped player receives the assist reward

grants: Sparkbearer aura until the next First Spark in that arena on that server: white-gold ribbon and a small crown beside the name, visible to everyone
arena-wide and server-wide toast naming the winner

permanent.unlock: title 'First Among Sparks' + crown count shown on the nameplate

crown.noLeaderboard: there is deliberately no crown ranking: a board would reward attendance, not skill

assist.to: every other player who landed a ring or lost a photo finish, when the capture succeeds
grants: album stamp 'Witnessed the First Spark' the first time

never: no reward that changes gameplay stats

fairness.solo: A solo player must land all three rings: reach 3 of 5 telegraphed glints, 30-60 studs apart, with 4.6 s between touchdowns. Hard, and identical for everyone. Solo rest time may be tuned separately (soloRestSeconds) if crowns prove much easier alone than contested
fairness.lateJoiners: can ring any remaining rest and can win. A player who arrives after it leaves sees the countdown to the next one
fairness.latency: photo finish + the standard 0.35 s view-clock rewind; ties are decided by loop size, never by arrival order inside the window
fairness.griefing: players do not collide and ribbons do not interact; nobody can block a glint or cancel another player's ring

profile.note: added in Profile v4 with the Legend fields
